port.ask: Serial port of the potentiostat (the USB virtual COM port)
port.help: Windows Device Manager lists it as 'EmStat4', 'ESPicoDev' or 'USB Serial Port'; on Linux it is /dev/ttyACM0 or /dev/ttyUSB0. PSTrace must be closed.

data_dir.ask: Folder where technique traces are saved as CSV

baud.ask: Baud rate (230400 for EmStat Pico and Sensit, 921600 for EmStat4 and Nexus)

max_run_s.ask: Longest technique the agent may start, seconds
